messages:
Maya (devex): Quick heads-up — we're targeting a coordinated bump to 2.6.0 across API, runtime, console, and SDKs. Cutoff for changelog PRs is Fri 15:00 PT. Please add a short bullet for the changelog if your PR affects behavior or public APIs.
Sam (runtime): Ack. I'll take runtime bump and verify compat with new API client. Expect PR by Thu EOD.
Jules (api): I'll open the api-server version-bump PR this afternoon. Labeling it release/2.6.0 and release:candidate. Will include migration note for the header format change.
Priya (release-manager): Thanks. I'll be the release owner for 2.6.0. Checklist: bump PRs opened, changelog entries, smoke canary on staging, tag created, release notes draft. Post your PR links here when ready.
Aaron (console): Console needs to update the SDK pin and the UI changelog page. I'll put a PR for package.json bump and a small UI note. ETA Fri morning.
Maya (devex): SDK owners — please prepare both js-sdk and py-sdk releases. For JS: update package.json, CHANGELOG.md header, run the integration tests against runtime branch. For Python: update setup.cfg and wheel metadata.
Sam (runtime): One gotcha — we changed an optional header name in the API. API team said it's backward-compatible, but please verify your integration tests. @Jules can you point to the exact commit?
Jules (api): Sure — commit 7b4f3c2 replaces X-Redwood-Trace -> x-redwood-trace (lowercase). It shouldn't break but the runtime client had case-sensitive checks in one path.
Sam (runtime): I'll add a unit test for the client header normalization. Will push in the runtime PR.
Aaron (console): If runtime needs a patch release after tests, we should coordinate the canary window. Priya — do we want a 24-hr canary on staging before tagging?
Priya (release-manager): Yes, standard flow: open PRs by cutoff, merge into release/2.6.0 branch, run canary on staging for 24 hrs (monitor latency/cpu), then tag and promote to prod. I'll handle the tagging.
Maya (devex): Small request: when opening changelog PRs, use the template header '2.6.0 — YYYY-MM-DD' and add a 1-line entry under Unreleased. This helps automation.
Jules (api): Will do. Also adding the label release:changelog so release-bot picks it up.
release-bot: Automated reminder: Changelog cutoff 2025-10-03T22:00:00Z (Fri 15:00 PT). After cutoff, only critical fixes will be accepted.
Sam (runtime): One more thing — SDKs need compat test matrix updated to include new runtime images. Maya, can you update the CI matrix or point to the job?
Maya (devex): I'll add a matrix row for runtime:2.6-rc in the SDK CI tomorrow. Tag me if PR fails.
Aaron (console): Any dependency bumps we should group? console depends on js-sdk@^2.5.0; I'll prepare a PR to bump to ^2.6.0 and run full e2e.
Jules (api): API docs generator will also need to bump the version string — I'll include that in the api PR.
Priya (release-manager): Please add the label release:ready when PRs have changelog + passing CI. I'll collect and schedule the merge. If anything blocks, ping me directly.
Maya (devex): Noted. I'll sweep tomorrow morning to remind anyone missing changelog entries.
Sam (runtime): Pushing runtime PR now. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482
Jules (api): API PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api-server/pull/911
Aaron (console): Console PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/327
Maya (devex): SDK PRs?
Sam (runtime): JS SDK draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/204
Jules (api): Py SDK draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/pull/158
Priya (release-manager): Perfect — I'll assemble release notes from those changelog bullets after cutoff and post the draft here. Anything else?
Aaron (console): If someone can confirm the runtime client header normalization test passes in CI, I'll merge the console PR after that.
Sam (runtime): CI green for the header test now.
Aaron (console): Merging console PR in 10.
Maya (devex): Thanks all — final reminder: add release:changelog + release:ready labels when done. I'll ping folks again at Fri 12:00 PT. :wave:
